**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263)
At last I have made out that last year’s blunder was that one short chapter of 8 pages was entirely missed over in the [counting](../others.html#102).

This half year there are 76 pp, for which the amount is naturally £9. 10- the pound added from last time makes it £10.. 10- and the slight margin Mr Mozley now allows for our good contributors enables me to make it £12.. 10- for which I enclose a cheque, hoping I have made no blunders this time.

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
I see the Franklyns advertised in the [Saturday](../others.html#99).

My Scottish friends, [Bp Mackenzie](../persons.html#929)’s [sisters](../persons.html#930) are so fond of the Wynnes they have just sent out a copy to the [married sister](../persons.html#589) at Natal.

[^1]: Envelope addressed to Miss Ann Smith/ 8 Wellington Road/ Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester 12 January 1863 and London SE 13 January 1863.
